summary: Public university in Kayseri with 13 four-year BSc programmes taught 100% in English and low published tuition. Its 2026-27 approved-exam list does not name the IB.
about: International applicants apply directly through AGU's portal; there is no application fee. Offers depend on an approved exam or diploma and on the Turkish diploma equivalency certificate.

ib.text: The IB is not named in AGU's 2026-27 approved exam list (SAT, ACT, A-levels and others are). A 2018-19 directive listed a Diploma minimum of 33. Ask AGU before applying with IB results.

admissionRoutes.text: The IB Diploma does not appear in the text of AGU's 2026-27 list of approved international exams. The 2018-19 directive listed a minimum grade of 33; treat that as historical and confirm with AGU.
No Course Results route is published. Meeting an AGU exam criterion does not guarantee the Turkish diploma equivalency certificate needed to register.

notes: Fall 2026 applications ran 19 Jan to 14 Aug 2026 (12:00 Turkish time); registration dates were 'to be announced'. Fall 2027 dates are not published.

Approved exams (2026-27 list, valid 2 years): SAT 1100/1600, ACT 24 with Maths and Science, GCE A-levels (for example 2 A-levels at C plus others), TR-YÖS percentile by programme. Candidates with 90%+ diplomas may get conditional admission and show an exam by registration.

English proof: IELTS is no longer accepted as proof by Turkish state universities (AGU says so); the undergraduate English requirements link was not read. AGU also runs its own English test. No IB English exemption was found.

Tuition for 2026-27, per year: USD 2,000 (engineering, architecture, life and natural sciences), USD 1,500 (managerial sciences), USD 1,400 (humanities and social sciences). Pay a pre-registration deposit within 7 days of acceptance, show proof of one semester's tuition, and buy health insurance. Fees are set by the Turkish Government yearly.
Programme pages: AGU's department sites were Turkish or unavailable, so programme links go to the International Office list. The 4-year length comes from the apply page.
